changes.title: Ley early clear
items: Clearing an area early no longer makes the ley line's pulse jump ahead to its runestone: the pulse keeps its pace along the line, and the area's wave celebrates when it gets there

changes.title: Soundsystems on the ground
items: Soundsystems stand on the ground again instead of sinking into it

changes.title: Dream thought bubbles
items: A sleeping legend's dream is now a pixel thought bubble: little clouds rising to a big one, showing one thing at a time (its face, the creature it dreams of, and now and then the relic flask)
